title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
This market refers to the Dota 2 Grand Final match between Xipto Esports and angry birds in the Esports Pro Circuit  Playoffs, initially scheduled for November 16, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET.

This market will resolve to "Xipto Esports" if Xipto Esports win Game 1 against angry birds.

This market will resolve to "angry birds" if angry birds win Game 1 against Xipto Esports.

If the match begins but is not completed, and Game 1 is concluded with a winner determined, this market will resolve based on the completed Game 1. 

If Game 1 is not completed for any reason, this market will resolve 50-50. 

If the match is canceled (not played at all), this market will resolve 50-50.

If the match is postponed, it must be rescheduled to a start time on or before November 30, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET (14 calendar days after the originally scheduled start of November 16, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET). If, by that deadline, the most recently announced rescheduled start time is on or before the deadline, this market resolves based on the result of the match as played. Otherwise, this market resolves 50-50, regardless of whether the match is subsequently played.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://www.dotabuff.com. However, if https://www.dotabuff.com has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.
